name: Crown of the Master (Greater)
text:
This crown, granted to favored azarketis by their alghollthu masters, is made of coral sculpted into the shape of a tentacled creature clutching the wearer's temples. While wearing the crown, you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects and can cast Figment as an occult innate spell.The crown gains the following activation.

Activate—Imperative Order 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cast a 6th-rank dominate with a DC of 30. When you cast dominate this way, its duration is reduced to 8 hours.
